lines.en: You look happy. How was the gathering?
It was warm. There was laughter all day.
Did you go to the walking club?
Yes, I went to the club this morning.
Who introduced you to them?
A volunteer introduced me to everyone this morning.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 자원봉사자가 모두에게 소개해 줬어요.

lines.en: I'm glad. A handshake makes new friends.
lines.ko: 다행이에요. 악수 한 번이 새 친구를 만들어요.

lines.en: Yes. Every conversation there is easy and warm.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 거기서는 모든 대화가 쉽고 따뜻해요.

lines.en: Will the club have a picnic soon?
Yes, next Sunday. Please come with me, dear.
lines.ko: 네, 다음 일요일이에요. 나와 함께 가요.

dialogs.about: 공원 모임에서 처음 만난 사람과 인사

lines.en: Hello. May I sit on this bench?
Of course. Please sit here with us.
Thank you. I am new to this gathering.
Welcome! Let me introduce you to my club.
That's kind. Are you all volunteers here?
Yes, we clean the park every Saturday.
Did you have a picnic here last week?
Yes, we ate together under the trees last week.
lines.ko: 네, 지난주에 나무 밑에서 함께 먹었어요.

lines.en: I don't feel like a stranger. Your laughter is warm.
lines.ko: 이제 낯선 사람 같지 않아요. 웃음이 참 따뜻해요.

lines.en: Let's end with a handshake. We will meet again.
